title: Light across type
description: A narrow highlight passes across the words, then leaves them at rest.
useCase: Add a restrained sheen to short launch copy or a status label.
interaction: Play or pause the text highlight
reducedMotion: The complete text remains visible with a solid color.
limitations: Clipped background gradients repaint. Keep text short and check contrast if adjusting the base color.
look: Dark charcoal page with a thin-outlined pill caption above a centred two-line grey sans headline, one word catching a white highlight.
motion: A narrow white gradient clipped to the text sweeps left to right, rests off-edge, sweeps back and rests again on a 4.5 s ease-in-out loop; a button pauses it.
adapt: The sweep is the `mg-shinytext-pass` keyframes moving a `linear-gradient` on `.mg-shinytext-shine` via `background-clip:text`; tune `background-size` (highlight width), the 4.5s duration and keyframe percentages for rest time. Replace the headline and pill copy.
